owner_rule: AGENTS DECIDE, LOCAL PYTHON EXECUTES. Measurements only; the certification RULING belongs to data-foundation-agent and is not made here.
subject: SEC companyfacts - is common shares outstanding available AS HISTORY?
why_this_exists: PH04 (net share issuance) was blocked because it was not established whether a shares-outstanding field is genuine filed-stamped history or a CURRENT SCALAR. The estate has a recorded scar on exactly this field shape - a current scalar used as history is look-ahead that no later test catches - so the question was worth settling rather than assuming in either direction.
method: Read-only sample of D:\Stock_Prediction_app_data\alpha_agent\identity\sec_bulk\companyfacts.zip (20,144 CIK entries). 220 CIKs drawn at seed 20260921. Nothing extracted to disk. A concept counts as HISTORY only when it carries MORE THAN ONE DISTINCT `filed` date for that issuer.

measurements.what: shares concepts present, filed-stamped, and multi-filing (= history)
measurements.how_measured: per sampled issuer, presence of the concept, presence of a `filed` field on its observations, and count of DISTINCT filed dates
measurements.result: of 220 issuers parsed - CommonStockSharesOutstanding present 142, filed-stamped 142, HISTORY 136; CommonStockSharesIssued 141/141/136; WeightedAverageNumberOfSharesOutstandingBasic 134/134/125; WeightedAverageNumberOfDilutedSharesOutstanding 128/128/120; dei:EntityCommonStockSharesOutstanding 155/155/150

measurements.how_measured: observation count per issuer for CommonStockSharesOutstanding
measurements.result: min 1, median 36, max 139 observations per issuer; filed-date span across sampled issuers 2009 .. 2026

measurements.how_measured: the three counts above read together
measurements.result: Shares outstanding is GENUINE FILED-STAMPED HISTORY, not a current scalar. Every observation carries its own `filed` date and the overwhelming majority of issuers carry many distinct filing dates. PH04 is expressible.

two_traps_the_sample_exposed.trap: RESTATEMENT - the same fiscal period appears more than once under different filings
two_traps_the_sample_exposed.evidence: Byrna Technologies (CIK0001354866): end=2010-11-30 appears twice, filed 2011-10-17 (10-Q) and filed 2012-03-13 (10-K), carrying DIFFERENT values.
two_traps_the_sample_exposed.required_handling: The estate's existing latest-filed-as-of-t restatement rule must be applied. A decision at t reads the most recent observation whose `filed` <= t, never the value later assigned to that period.

two_traps_the_sample_exposed.trap: NEGATIVE SHARE COUNTS - a plain data error that a ratio would amplify
two_traps_the_sample_exposed.evidence: Byrna Technologies: end=2010-11-30 val=-25878050, later corrected to +25878050 under a different accession.
two_traps_the_sample_exposed.required_handling: Non-positive share counts must be dropped by a DECLARED filter before any issuance ratio is formed. A year-over-year issuance ratio spanning a sign flip produces an enormous spurious value, and a cross-sectional rank book would place that name at an extreme every time. This filter must be pre-registered, not discovered during evaluation.

what_this_does_not_settle: Per-field coverage BY YEAR for the extension universe was not measured here; CERTIFICATION_DF4A_COMPANYFACTS.json carries it as NOT_MEASURED and the director should treat PH03/PH04 coverage as a limitation that travels.
The ticker -> CIK join for the extension universe specifically. DF4A measured 99.4% against an FSDS-derived mid/small-cap CIK set, not against the certified Norgate extension symbol list.
Nothing here rules on whether net share issuance has alpha.

hypotheses_affected.PH04_EQ_EXTENSION_NET_SHARE_ISSUANCE: UNBLOCKED on evidence, conditional on the restatement rule and the declared non-positive-share filter travelling with the dataset
